description: This file defines data structures and a class for loading unit conversion data within a calculator application. It includes definitions for ordered units, unit data, explicit conversion data, and a data loader class that interacts with external data sources to retrieve categories, units, and conversion ratios.

classes.name: UnitConverterDataLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading unit conversion data based on geographic region, implementing the IConverterDataLoader interface.

methods.name: LoadData
methods.description: Loads unit conversion data from external sources.

methods.name: GetOrderedCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories of units in a specific order.

methods.name: GetOrderedUnits
methods.description: Retrieves units within a category in a specific order.

methods.name: LoadOrderedRatios
methods.description: Loads conversion ratios for a specific unit.

methods.name: SupportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is supported.

methods.name: GetUnits
methods.description: Populates a map of units categorized by view mode.

methods.name: GetExplicitConversionData
methods.description: Retrieves explicit conversion data between units.

methods.name: GetLocalizedStringName
methods.description: Retrieves localized string name for a given string ID.
